citation: Major-Pedersen et al. 2008. Effects of Oral Glucose Load on Endothelial Function and on Insulin and Glucose Fluctuations in Healthy Individuals. Experimental Diabetes Research 2008:672021.
protocol: 75 g glucose in 200 mL; blood pre-load and at 1, 2, 3, 4 h; placebo-load day for comparison
population: 10 healthy adults (4 F, 6 M), age 41.1 +/- 3.0, BMI 23.2
note: Long 4-h sampling with a water-placebo control on another day. Fasting glucose is low (4.1 mmol/L). Small n; units mmol/L and uU/L.
